question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**perceived**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, the blank 4 will indicate the harm that the red kites caused to the livestock.
 
• Now, among the given options:
 
 
• **The word "perceived" means to become aware of something through the senses or intuition. **(महसूस किया)
 
 
 
• **The sentence suggests that something was perceived by someone or something.**
 
• The word is in past tense, indicating that the action has already happened.
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "perceived" fits in the context of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "kicked", means to strike with the foot or feet.(निकाल दिया)
 
• Option 2, "dirty", means not clean or pure.(गंदा)
 
• Option 4, "shipped", means to transport or send something by ship, aircraft, train, or truck.(जहाज़ या यातायात के अन्‍य साधन द्वारा कुछ भेजना या ले जाना)

200:Ta7d,

The correct answer is "**killed**".
